axis: a half-formed guess held lightly → an idea credited and firmly held

members.tone: Faintly disparaging: the impression treated as manufactured, something staged to be taken a certain way rather than one that simply arose.
The softest of these, holding the vague idea as sensation and claiming no grounds for it, where *belief* claims firmness.
Dresses the same vague idea as a position one would state and stand behind, more assertive than *impression* though no better founded.
Tilts the guess toward something being wrong, so wariness comes attached where *hunch* stays neutral about what it points at.
The plainest word here, naming the idea as something received without judging how well it stands up.
The firmest of these, treating the vague idea as accepted rather than merely entertained, so the confidence carries further than in *feeling*.
Slightly belittling: the idea sounds light and half-formed, entertained rather than held.
Neutral and bodily, naming not a guess about how things are but the sense that something is there.
Dignifies the guess, crediting it as a kind of knowing rather than a stab in the dark.
Informal and unpretentious, owning the guess as a guess and claiming none of the insight *intuition* claims.
